evals.description: Sync the project mcud xrpc YAML into SPC-Interface.
evals.prompt: 把 C:\HQ_Workspace\YLB04_A6\code\task-jpz_dev\mpu\app\mcud\business\xrpc\process_define.yaml 定义的函数同步到 C:\HQ_Workspace\YLB04_A6\code\task-jpz_dev\mpu\app\mcud\doc\mcud.xlsx 的 SPC-Interface 工作表。
evals.expected_output: Workbook is updated in place, Function count matches YAML processes, and each Function has a RETURN Int32 row.
criteria: Creates a backup before modifying the workbook
Preserves SPC-Interface header and template style
Writes one RETURN row for every Function
Sets every RETURN type to Int32
Sets RETURN description to >=0 表示执行成功； <0 错误码

evals.description: Handle a process with no input_params and no output_params.
evals.prompt: 同步一个 process_define.yaml，其中某个 process 的 input_params: [] 且 output_params: []。
evals.expected_output: The Function still has one RETURN row with Int32 and the standard return description.
criteria: Does not skip empty-parameter process entries
Adds a Function row with Normal type
Adds RETURN / Int32 / >=0 表示执行成功； <0 错误码
Does not add blank bogus parameter rows

evals.description: Preserve String and ByteArray fixed lengths.
evals.prompt: 同步一个 process_define.yaml，其中参数包含 param_type: String, param_len: 64 和 param_type: ByteArray, param_len: 16。
evals.expected_output: The SPC parameter types are written as String[64] and ByteArray[16].
criteria: Converts String with param_len to String[n]
Converts ByteArray with param_len to ByteArray[n]
Copies other scalar types as-is
Keeps IN and OUT modifiers from the YAML section

evals.prompt: 把 process_define.yaml 同步到 C:\missing\mcud.xlsx。
criteria: Reports that the workbook path does not exist
Does not create a new workbook silently
Asks for a valid workbook path

evals.description: Target worksheet header is not the SPC-Interface template.
evals.prompt: 同步到一个存在 SPC-Interface 工作表但表头不是七列 SPC 接口模板的 workbook。
criteria: Reads row 1 before editing
Detects unexpected headers
Stops before overwriting data
Reports expected header names
